stories.title: Shankar Agrawal sent to custody despite Supreme Court bail order
stories.summary: Kathmandu, September 29 Businessman Shankar Agrawal, who had been ordered released on bail by the Supreme Court, has been sent to custody by the Special Court. A bench of Supreme Court justices Balkrishna Dhakal and Nrip Dhwaj Niraula had ordered Agrawal’s release on bail of Rs 1 million in a banking offence case.
